title: 第7章 守护之心也非要分出高尚和低贱吗第8章 鹿辞霜不媚男不媚女纯慕强
slug: 开局逼我献祭我有天道赐福
content_zh:
男人没忍住，噗嗤笑了出来。
女人立刻把炮火对准了男人：“笑笑笑，就知道笑！孩子化学不好就随你们老温家！”
男人缩了缩脑袋，连忙求饶：“好好好，我的错，别生气啊，老婆。”
男人哄了几句后，女人又把注意力放在了温郗身上。
“今天是不是出物理成绩啊？考多少？”
温郗默默看向男人。
她用眼神示意——“救我！”
男人对她使着眼色——“别搞，我也不想死！”
温郗瞪了瞪眼睛——
“我物理卷子要是拿出来，你就等着老妈掀房子吧，到时候——”
“都！别！活！”
男人：……
他闭了闭眼睛，视死如归地松开手，将女人刚炒好的一盘糖醋排骨摔在了地上。
清脆的盘子碎裂声音响起，整个房子里的空气似乎都凝滞了。
温郗低头，抿着唇慢慢远离厨房区域。
男人回头，讪笑道：“嘿嘿，老婆，不小心手滑了。”
女人：……
温郗屏气凝神，在女人收拾男人的混乱中，悄悄拿起书包走上了楼梯，离开前还对自己老爸郑重地竖了个大拇指。
谋士以身入局，她老爸真帅。
躺在自己房间的床上，温郗呼出一口气，内心一片安宁。

她起身拉开衣柜，五颜六色的漂亮小裙子映入眼帘，温郗抬手摸了摸一件淡蓝色的裙子，只觉得有些恍惚。
她总觉得，自己似乎穿了许多年的白色……
在这里，温郗有着健康的身体，可以奔跑、跳跃，可以肆无忌惮地吃任何想吃的东西。
父母陪伴在侧，带她去游乐园，陪她过生日，送她去上学，吵吵闹闹……
很幸福，也有不少小摩擦。
好真实啊。
夕阳西下的傍晚，温郗一家三口在公园散步。
男人摸了摸温郗的头发：“不知不觉，我家闺女已经十七岁了，我已经在期待你十八岁生日那天了。”
女人也笑了：“是啊，那时候我要好好准备准备。”
温郗的脚步停住了，她的眼底闪过一抹淡绿色光辉，转瞬即逝。
夕阳将三人的影子拉得很长。
温郗看着父母眼中那浓得化不开的爱意，心脏像是被一只冰冷的手紧紧攥住，疼得几乎窒息。
她极其缓慢地抽出了自己的手臂，眼中已有水光，眼底却是清明与坚定。
content_en:
The man couldn't hold it back and burst into laughter.
The woman immediately pointed her cannon at the man: "Smile, smile, you know how to laugh! If your child is not good at chemistry, just follow your old Wen family!"
The man shrank his head and quickly begged for mercy: "Okay, okay, my fault, don't be angry, wife."
After the man coaxed for a few words, the woman turned her attention to Wen Xi.
"Are the physics results coming out today? How much is the test?"
Wen Xi looked at the man silently.
She signaled with her eyes - "Help me!"
The man winked at her - "Don't do it, I don't want to die either!"
Wen Xi stared—
"If I take out the physics paper, just wait for my mother to blow up the house. When the time comes-"
"Both! Don't! Live!"
Man:…
He closed his eyes, let go of his hand as if he were dead, and threw the plate of sweet and sour pork ribs that the woman had just fried to the ground.
There was a crisp sound of plates breaking, and the air in the whole house seemed to be stagnant.
Wen Xi lowered his head, pursed his lips and slowly moved away from the kitchen area.
The man turned around and said with a smile: "Hey, wife, my hand slipped accidentally."
Woman:…
Wen Xi held his breath and concentrated. In the chaos of the woman cleaning up the man, he quietly picked up his schoolbag and walked up the stairs. Before leaving, he gave his father a solemn thumbs up.
The counselor entered the situation personally, her father is so handsome.
Lying on the bed in his room, Wen Xi exhaled, feeling peaceful inside.
She stood up and opened the wardrobe, and colorful and beautiful little skirts came into view. Wen Xi raised his hand and touched a light blue skirt, feeling a little dazed.
She always felt as if she had been wearing white for many years...
Here, Wen Xi has a healthy body, can run, jump, and eat whatever he wants without restraint.
Her parents were by her side, taking her to the amusement park, celebrating her birthday with her, sending her to school, noisily...
It's very happy, and there are a lot of little frictions.
So true.
In the evening as the sun set, Wen Xi's family of three took a walk in the park.
The man touched Wen Xi's hair: "Unknowingly, my daughter is already seventeen years old, and I am already looking forward to your eighteenth birthday."
The woman also smiled: "Yes, I will be well prepared then."
Wen Xi's footsteps stopped, and a light green light flashed in her eyes, and it disappeared briefly.
The setting sun stretched the shadows of the three people very long.
Wen Xi looked at the overwhelming love in his parents' eyes, and his heart seemed to be squeezed tightly by a cold hand, almost suffocating from the pain.
She pulled out her arm extremely slowly. There was water in her eyes, but her eyes were clear and firm.
